text: My dad destroyed a whole supermarket... with one sentence.
In this world, dad jokes deal real damage.
Every groan hits like a punch.
A tiny pun? Ten damage. Knock knock jokes? Windows explode.
That's why Mom wears a helmet at dinner.
Me? My jokes do zero damage. Nobody even groans.
Kids call me Zero Damage.
Then one day, at the supermarket, I saw Lily.
So did my dad.
He grabbed a lettuce and said...
Lettuce introduce ourselves!
speaker: dad

text: Boom. Cereal everywhere.
I covered his mouth. He licked my hand.
I hid in the freezer. He said, chill out.
Subscribe, because then Lily's dad showed up... holding a melon.
Two dads. One aisle. Pun battle.
Shopping carts flew. The milk hit orbit.
That's when I realized something.
Groans hurt. But real laughs heal.
So I told Lily my worst joke ever.
Why did the cookie see a doctor? It felt crummy.
Zero damage. Because she laughed. For real.
Everyone healed. Even the milk came back down.
Then she said, your jokes are my favorite.
Mom showed up... still wearing the helmet.
Subscribe if your dad is a weapon.
